An Ordinance to

[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part-I, 28th August, 2002]
F.No.2(1)/2002-Pub. dated 28th
August, 2002.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the President is
hereby published for general information:---
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Pakistan Merchant
Shipping (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Insertion of new section 79A, Ordinance No.LII of 2001

PAKISTAN MERCHANT SHIPPING (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
PAKISTAN MERCHANT
SHIPPING (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XLVII OF
2002
An Ordinance to
amend the Pakistan Merchant Shipping Ordinance, 2001
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part-I, 28th August, 2002]
F.No.2(1)/2002-Pub. dated 28th
August, 2002.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the President is
hereby published for general information:---
2. Insertion of new section
79A, Ordinance No.LII of 2001.---In the Pakistan Merchant Shipping
Ordinance, 2001 (LII of 2001), after section 79, the following section shall be
inserted, namely:--
"79A. Regulation and
determination of port charges by Shipping Companies and Shining Agents etc.,---(1)
The Federal Government shall regulate and determine port charges and other
local charges, other than the charges leviable under the Ports Act, 1908 (XV of
1908), to be levied by the shipping Companies and Shipping Agents in respect of
the cargo handled at port.
(2) Notwithstanding anything
contained in any other law for the rime being in force, the licences to
Shipping Companies, Shipping Agents tend Non-vessels Operating Carries and
Cargo Consolidations shall only be issued after grant of NOC from the Shipping
Rates Advisory Board constituted under subsection (2) of section 79 or by an
authority authorised by the Board.
(3) Only those Shipping Companies
and Shipping Agents, Non- vessles Operating Carriers and Cargo Consolidators
who are registered with the Ports and Shipping Wing of Communications Division
shall be allowed to work in the ports.
Explanation. ---For the
purpose of this section "port" means the port specified in First
Schedule to the Ports Act, 1908 (XV of 1908) or any port which may be notified
by the Federal Government for the purpose of this section.
(4) In the case of default under
subsection (1) or subsection (2), by any Shipping Company, Shipping Agents,
Non-vessel Operating Carrier or Cargo Consolidation, the Federal Government
shall have the power to cancel the registration, forfeit the security or impose
penalty or fine as may be Prescribed."
